title: Real Numbers
summary: Real numbers, Euclid's division lemma, Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic, irrationality of √2, √3, √5, decimal expansions of rational numbers in terms of terminating/non-terminating recurring decimals.

title: Polynomials
summary: Zeros of a polynomial, relationship between zeros and coefficients of quadratic polynomials, factorisation of polynomials, algebraic identities.

title: Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables
summary: Graphical method of solution, consistency/inconsistency, algebraic conditions for number of solutions, solution by substitution, elimination, and cross-multiplication, situational problems.

title: Quadratic Equations
summary: Standard form ax² + bx + c = 0 (a ≠ 0), solutions by factorisation, and by using quadratic formula, relationship between discriminant and nature of roots, situational problems based on daily activities.

title: Arithmetic Progressions
summary: Motivation for studying AP, derivation of nth term and sum of first n terms, application in solving daily life problems.

title: Triangles
summary: Definitions, examples, and counter examples of similar triangles, conditions for similarity (AA, SSS, SAS), theorems about proportional sides and equal angles, Pythagorean theorem and its converse.

title: Coordinate Geometry
summary: Review of concepts of coordinate geometry, graphs of linear equations, distance formula, section formula (internal division), area of a triangle.

title: Introduction to Trigonometry
summary: Trigonometric ratios of an acute angle of a right-angled triangle, proof of their existence, motivation of ratios at 0° and 90°, values of trigonometric ratios of 30°, 45°, and 60°, trigonometric identities.

title: Some Applications of Trigonometry
summary: Introduction to trigonometry, angles of elevation and depression, problems on heights and distances with angles of 30°, 45°, and 60° only.

title: Circles
summary: Tangent to a circle at the point of contact, perpendicular radius to tangent, lengths of tangents drawn from an external point are equal.

title: Constructions
summary: Division of a line segment in a given ratio, construction of tangents to a circle, construction of similar triangles.

title: Areas Related to Circles
summary: Area of sectors and segments of a circle, problems based on areas and perimeter/circumference of the above-said plane figures, central angles of 60°, 90°, and 120° only.

title: Surface Areas and Volumes
summary: Surface areas and volumes of combinations of any two of the following: cubes, cuboids, spheres, hemispheres, and right circular cylinders/cones. Problems involving converting one solid shape to another.

title: Statistics
summary: Mean, median, and mode of grouped data (bimodal situation to be avoided), cumulative frequency graph.

title: Probability
summary: Classical definition of probability, simple problems in finding the probability of an event.
